translations.web: Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.
translations.bsb: Why do you boast of evil, O mighty man? The loving devotion of God endures all day long.
translations.kjv: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.
translations.asv: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? The lovingkindness of God endureth continually.
